fixture_import: Eight explicit synthetic prior-receipt records, no optimizer updates. Source verification independently recreated.
protected_gradient_inputs: Sequential private graph per old record, read-only prestate.
zero_sign: IEEE NumPy float64 addition then direct float32 cast, no signed-zero canonicalization.
session_key: hash of canonical public run descriptors except full transaction array, includes arm/fit/base/delay/phase.
receipt_context: initial uses fitNN, main uses baseNN, fixture and probes use caseN; scopes and exact contexts recorded.
main_maps: only old before fixture/probe; development after initial fits; heldout after B1 A0/calibration lock.
solver_status: finite support/KKT numbers not score feedback; explicit frozen formulas.
schema: max raw frame 512KiB, header64KiB; record-type max counts/shapes independent ledger.
time_sources: monotonic runtime observations excluded from deterministic replay
